text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both down modestly over 24 hours, with Ethereum underperforming slightly, while altcoins show steeper losses—suggesting risk-off rotation toward the largest assets. The Fear & Greed Index sits at extreme fear despite a 9-point weekly gain, and volume remains subdued at $75B, indicating limited conviction either direction. Bitcoin's dominance holding at 56% reflects cautious capital consolidation rather than panic capitulation.
